comment: Unless you came into his class having immense outside knowledge or having a class with him before, you will not succeed. His favorites are clear, while his grading standards are not. His standards are impossibly high (coming from someone who did well) and he will accuse you of cheating if you do well even without evidence.

I began this class massively interested in Political Theory, and left it with a repulsion towards academia altogether. Simply, this class was a forum for this professor to rant about his opinion, criticize others, and laugh while doing so. Any professor who sends 3-page emails has lost his touch with reality.
Read the reviews and check the grades people got in the course.
Pros: very smart professor. Cons: 1. class is impossible 2. An insane amount of work during the entire year, and especially at the end of the semester.

Knowledgable individual but bad teacher. The teacher is self aware of his own unreasonable expectations and treats complaints/requests for leniency as a sign of incompetence and weakness. It is impossible to succeed in this class unless you dedicate all of your time to it. Do not take.

Brutal class and very difficult. Only those who genuinely enjoy american political theory should think to take this. Very nitpicky with details and you have to basically have PHD level knowledge to attempt to get above a B+ I would suggest any other course for political theory.
I would avoid this class. Trust me.
The best professor I've had. He is very supportive and grades fairly. The classes and materials are very interesting, but be prepared for a lot of heavy reading.

I loved this class! I will say that there will be a lot of readings (25+ pages). It will be smart to stay on top of it, as you go over one chapter each class. The class is what you make of it! Participate, Read the chapters, take useful notes, and listen to what he says in the lectures. He's so sweet, so recommend taking him!

Professor Cherry is amazing and extremely knowledgeable about Political Theory. He is a tough grader but gives valuable feedback. You will also have the chance to revise the first essay you complete. Please go to his office hours if you are confused on anything and he will clear things up for you!

Dr. Cherry is the best and is so funny. He loves what he does and it makes the class so much more enjoyable. There are a lot of papers and tests, but they are well thought out and the lowest score from each was dropped so it was not too bad.

A wonderful professor, but expects a lot out of students. Lot of reading nightly, plus 3 tests, 2 papers (you revise the 1st one), and a low stakes assessment. Grades somewhat harshly on assignments but is always accessible to discuss your work. The best prof to learn political theory from at UR, so take him if you're interested and ready to work.

Dr. Cherry is by far one of the most incredible professors I have ever had! He is truly an expert in his field and is one of the most caring people ever. The class is tough and you really have to do the readings in order to succeed, but putting in the work for this class will make you a better student overall. I am so grateful I took this class!

Cherry knows his stuff and is super passionate about the work he teaches but class time can be super boring. You HAVE to read for the class or your gonna do poorly. He is a super hard grader so do not expect to cruise by.

The most inspirational professor within the Political Science cohort. His class will make you approac ancient texts as if they are a puzzle. Dr. Cherry is a tough grader but you will leave class as a better version of yourself for sure. He is very caring, understanding, helpful as well as gracious. He is a virtuous man himself like the ancients!

Professor Cherry is a good professor.  He's caring and his class seems easy at first but it is very reading heavy and his lectures don't really teach you much to be completely honest.  You HAVE to read for this class or else his tests will be very difficult.  Other than that he is an understanding and caring professor.

A class that really makes you work for it but an amazing professor. Makes the syllabus flexible so that if you have a crazy week there are work arounds. Super accessible outside of class and really understanding when it comes to being sick. The material is hard and he grades really hard, but he wants his students to succeed and tries to help you.

As an unexceptional student, his comments on my papers were always very thorough, thoughtful, and kind. Class day to day is more of what you and your peers make of it than the average humes professor, but the online lectures, flexible class structure, and usefulness of the material make the class absolutely worth taking for all types of learner.
Professor Cherry was a fantastic professor. There was certainly a lot of reading, but hes a great lecturer. He really knows the content and cares about it. Would definitely take him again

Dr. Cherry is the most caring professor I have had at U of R. He constantly worked with the class to create a workload that was both interesting/challenging, but also manageable. He allowed us to select our major assignments: 4 tests (can drop one) and two papers (revisions on one). Very fair grader. Readings are manageable and interesting.

Hes literally one of the kindest professors Ive encountered so far at richmond. He is receptive to students and makes you feel like your thoughts and opinions actually matter. Dr Cherry is super knowledgeable and makes the class discussions interesting. There is a decent amount of reading but if you stay on top of it its not too bad. 10/10

Dr. Cherry has made his FYS quite enjoyable with great readings, a fair, but manageable, number of essays, and lively discussions. While at points the reading becomes very heavy, this is balanced by other points where there is less reading and his ability to work with students to make life manageable. Overall, Dr. Cherry is kind and a helpful prof.

Great professor! He really knows his stuff. There are a decent amount of readings, but if you keep up with them and take good notes during lectures, you will be fine. The discussion is interesting. The class is structured to where it is challenging but not ridiculously so. He genuinely cares about his students and allows for their input.

Horrible, only lectures and you don't actually learn anything. Unecessarilly hard, I've gotten A's in all of my political science classes, but this one is just ridiculously unfair and extra work for no reason.
My 5 year old cousin speaks more clearly than he does. Rather than sit in his class, I'd prefer to watch paint dry.

Cherry is an amazing professor. He was extremely knowledgeable about every work we read and was very clear in his explanations. I also went to his office at entirely random times for help (not office hours), and he didn't even hesitate to drop what he was doing to help me. He really cares about his students, taking a class with him again this year

Professor Cherry is awesome. It's hard and there is a lot of work, but stay up with the reading and study hard for tests and you will be fine. Participate in class and go to his office hours. You get out of this class what you put in.
Great professor who cares a lot about students; really helped me during a difficult period in my life.
Just a great enthusiastic professor that is really knowledgable about the subject manner and wants his students to learn as much as possible.

Very sharp guy who really cares about his students.  Expects a great deal out of your writing but is eager to work with you toward improvement.  He is tremendously knowledgeable and passionate about the subject area which makes class engaging.
